description: The control of nested-priority-alone with both T written: on A T T, r reads the first T as [T] and the second as its last T. That witness omits nothing, so begins of r holds, although the witness that leaves out [T] is not eligible (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T
%rule text A T T
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r A [T] T
